description_short: Exports read-only factory counts, machine inventory, production identities and configurations, reserves, operating history, and train traffic health to the local CoI calculator.
description_long: Writes a local JSON snapshot containing vehicle totals, selected completed/running entity counts, Groundwater Pump identity, pause state, locations, and vehicle-zone membership, computing capacity, stable Chicken Farm identities, settings, populations, and vehicle-zone membership, stable greenhouse identities and configurations, eligible standalone Gold and Fuel Gas reserves, current repeatable research and edicts, completed-cycle operating averages, and sustained train track waits. It does not modify gameplay state or expose a network service.
